tools.name: list_services
tools.description: Discover the currently enabled public SignalHarness service catalog before choosing a service. This free, read-only call takes no arguments and returns a compact service array with canonical IDs, descriptions, prices, and supported payment metadata. Results follow the canonical catalog order; compar

tools.name: get_service
tools.description: Inspect one enabled public SignalHarness service before invoking it. Use an exact service_id returned by list_services. This free, read-only call returns the canonical description, input and output schemas, price, endpoint, and supported payment metadata when available; an unknown or disabled ID ret

tools.name: invoke_service
tools.description: Run exactly one enabled public SignalHarness service with caller-supplied input. Call get_service first and validate input against its input_schema.
